The '''Cestian anthem''' was the official [[Music/Legends|anthem]] of the<ref name="TCD" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCD" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was [[Mission to Ord Cestus|sent]] to Ord Cestus to prevent the sale of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[JK-13 security droid]]s, which posed a significant threat to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Upon his arrival in Ord Cestus's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[ChikatLik]], a [[Band/Legends|band]] of [[musician droid]]s greeted the Knight's party with renditions of the [[Cestian]] anthem and "[[All Stars Burn as One]]," the official anthem of the Republic. For Kenobi, the Cestian anthem sounded like a medley of melodic bleeps and hoots.<ref name="TCD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The anthem appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'', which was written by [[Steven Barnes]].<ref name="TCD" />
